evals.prompt: Review the UI of evals/fixtures/demo-site/index.html and pricing.html. Skip the questions.
evals.setup: Shell with Playwright; serve evals/fixtures/demo-site over http. Deliberate UI problems: *:focus outline none, pale greys (2.2–3.1:1), a 1,000+ px feature strip (sideways scroll at 768 and 360), a promo bar inserted after load (CLS > 0.1 at 360), an infinite pulse that ignores reduced motion, mixed icon styles, four button radii, eleven font sizes, off-scale spacing, two off-palette oranges.
expectations: inspect_ui.py runs at 360, 768 and 1280; checks cite it as src
Focus, contrast, sideways scroll, layout shift, motion, icon styles, radii, type scale and spacing are all found
Invisible focus is severity 4 and in the top 3
Placeholder-only labels, password type and 'Submit' copy are noted as out of scope (ux-review), not issues
Every task has where and measured current values; every mark sits on its element
validate_audit.py, check_report.py pass; build_handoff.py writes handoff.md and tasks.json
forbidden: A contrast ratio, size or count not in the inspect output
Treating the fake countdown as a UI fix instead of pointing to ux-review / product-lens-audit

evals.prompt: Review talkable-like-site.com home, pricing, demo and case-study pages. English report + handoff, private artifact.
evals.setup: The sandbox cannot reach the site; Claude in Chrome is available but its window cannot be resized (fullscreen, page zoom 80%).
expectations: The probe is pasted into the browser and run inside a same-origin iframe at exactly 360, 768 and 1280
Screenshots are cropped to the iframe and resized to the exact width
inspect_ui.py from the sandbox is listed as 'no' with the reason
Automatic contrast false positives (hidden labels, layered backgrounds) are not reported as issues
No form is submitted
forbidden: Measurements taken at the window's real width presented as 1280

evals.prompt: Review the UI of example.com, no questions please.
evals.setup: Claude app with a browser tool but no code execution. The person skips every question.
expectations: Each start question appears in answers with skipped=true and an assumption
Values come from scripts/probe.js pasted into the browser, or the source is marked demo
Checks that could not be run are shown with v:null, and the missing tool is a 'no' source
The report is built by copying the template and replacing the JSON block; shots without src show placeholder frames with marks
forbidden: Claiming inspect_ui.py results when no shell was available

evals.prompt: Here are 5 screenshots of our mobile app's checkout. What should we fix?
evals.setup: No browser, no connectors. Files: 5 PNG screenshots, 1170×2532.
expectations: Marks are placed on the screenshots by eye and kept generous; shots use the given files
Colour values read off the images are labelled approximate and the source is demo
Focus, motion, CLS and dark mode are hypotheses or 'no data', never observed
where uses the screen name and shot id instead of a CSS selector
forbidden: Claiming to have opened the live app
Exact contrast ratios presented as measured

evals.prompt: Review our dashboard UI against our design system. Tokens are in src/styles/tokens.css.
evals.setup: Repo with a tokens file; the app runs at localhost.
expectations: tokens in audit.json come from the tokens file and the source is ok
Target values name existing tokens; no new colours are invented when a token fits
Hard-coded values that match no token are reported under design-system consistency with a count

evals.prompt: Review the settings page of app.example.com
evals.setup: The page needs a login the agent does not have.
expectations: The agent does not try to sign up or guess credentials; it asks the person to sign in or send screenshots
The browser source is marked no for the logged-in screens, and confidence drops

evals.prompt: Review app.example.com/onboarding and give me a task file my coding agent can work through. English, please.
expectations: lang is en; handoff.md and tasks.json are delivered next to the report with the screenshots they reference
Tasks are ordered by ICE with dependencies first; each has acceptance criteria and how to verify
Selectors in where actually match an element on the page (inspect_ui.py --sel finds them)

evals.prompt: Re-review the site after our fixes, here is last month's audit.json.
evals.setup: A previous audit.json is attached and some fixes shipped.
expectations: The report says which tasks were done and how each check moved (e.g. contrast 60/97 -> 95/97)
Start questions already answered in the previous audit are not asked again
